title.zh: 照片马赛克 · 拼图揭幕

summary.en: Reveal a photo mosaic by pulling back from individual pictures to the complete image.
summary.zh: 多张照片组成主视觉，从局部照片拉远揭示完整马赛克，适合集体回忆与拼图揭幕。

subtitle.zh: 照片马赛克 · 拼图揭幕

materials.en: Tiles: text entries, at least 20 items, at most 256 items.
materials.zh: Tiles：文字内容，至少 20 项，最多 256 项。
Title：文字，不超过 80 个字符。
Titleen：文字，不超过 80 个字符。
Kicker：文字，不超过 80 个字符。
Ink：文字，不超过 7 个字符。
Paper：文字，不超过 7 个字符。

materials.en: Soundtrackmode: text. New videos use external-music (current API/user music + source effects). No music means effects-only; none mutes music and effects. template-score only preserves an explicitly approved existing score. Voice is independent..

materials.zh: Voiceover：文字，不超过 240 个字符。

materials.en: Music: text, up to 240 characters. For external-music, a nonempty relative path under --inputs to this production's prepared background.wav; other modes require an empty or absent music path..
materials.zh: Music：文字，不超过 240 个字符。

dependencies.en: The package declares a Python and Node.js host. Check its dependency lock for supported versions and any additional rendering tools.
dependencies.zh: 模板声明使用 Python 和 Node.js。具体工具与版本以下载包为准。

dependencies.en: Use the package dependency lock and setup/check instructions. Check existing tools first, install only missing requirements and verify a preview.
dependencies.zh: 按下载包的依赖锁和 setup/check 说明检查已有工具，只补齐缺项，并验证预览。

en: Make the user's photos into the existing visual composition; retain every original effect and time cue.
zh: Make the user's photos into the existing visual composition; retain every original effect and time cue.

en: The documented output is 1920 × 1080, 60 fps; default demo duration is 14 seconds.
Use the actual package parameter bounds; extra materials do not automatically create extra scenes.
Arbitrary portrait output or scene rearrangement without a separately adapted design.
zh: 已声明输出为 1920 × 1080，60 fps；默认样片 14 秒。
按实际包的参数边界制作；增加素材不会自动增加场景。

capabilities.en: Optional services require a live catalog, template slot and account check before they can be confirmed.
capabilities.zh: 配套服务需核对官网实时能力、模板槽位和账号权限后才能确认。
